recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下為混合性浸潤：小淋巴球、漿細胞樣細胞、具淡粉紅色細胞質的上皮樣組織球、散在嗜酸性球，右側可見多核巨細胞與層狀粉紅色角蛋白碎屑，呈肉芽腫樣反應，屬邊緣區淋巴瘤背景中的伴隨變化。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular dense nuclei
Plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei admixed
Epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei
Multinucleated giant cells, one adjacent to laminated eosinophilic keratinous material (foreign-body type reaction)
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules; occasional mitotic figure
describe_en: At high power the dermal infiltrate is polymorphous, composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells, admixed with epithelioid histiocytes, scattered eosinophils and multinucleated giant cells. One giant cell lies adjacent to laminated eosinophilic keratinous debris, suggesting a foreign-body reaction to ruptured adnexal keratin. No sheets of large transformed cells are identified in this field. These reactive components can be seen in extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of the skin and should not distract from the clonal plasmacytic B-cell population demonstrated by ancillary studies.

ddx.dx: Ruptured follicular cyst or folliculitis with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: A purely reactive process lacks the light-chain-restricted B-cell/plasmacytic population and the destructive diffuse lymphoid infiltrate seen elsewhere in the lesion.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in the mixed background, which are not identified here.
LCH shows sheets of grooved-nucleus CD1a/langerin-positive cells with eosinophils rather than epithelioid histiocytes with keratin-associated giant cells.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous features
ddx.vs: Granulomatous MF shows atypical cerebriform T cells and epidermotropism with a monoclonal TCR rearrangement.
